arxiv-2102-08218.title: Unifying Lower Bounds on Prediction Dimension of Consistent Convex Surrogates
arxiv-2102-08218.creator: Jessie Finocchiaro, Rafael Frongillo, Bo Waggoner
arxiv-2102-08218.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jessie Finocchiaro, Rafael Frongillo, Bo Waggoner. Given a prediction task, understanding when one can and cannot design a consistent convex surrogate loss, particularly a low-dimensional one, is an important and active area of machine learning research. The prediction task may be given as a target loss, as in classification and structured prediction, or simply as a (conditional) statistic of the data, as in risk measure estimation. These two scenarios typically involve different techniques for designing and analyzing surrogate losses.

arxiv-2111-05288.title: Adiabatic waveforms from extreme-mass-ratio inspirals: an analytical approach Preprint: YITP-21-114, KUNS-2901, OCU-PHYS-551, AP-GR-175
arxiv-2111-05288.creator: Soichiro Isoyama, Ryuichi Fujita, Alvin J. K. Chua, Hiroyuki Nakano, Adam Pound, Norichika Sago
arxiv-2111-05288.description: Abstract Scientific analysis for the gravitational-wave detector LISA will require theoretical waveforms from extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) that extensively cover all possible orbital and spin configurations around astrophysical Kerr black holes. However, on-the-fly calculations of these waveforms have not yet overcome the high dimensionality of the parameter space.

arxiv-2112-05302.title: Realized GARCH, CBOE VIX, and the Volatility Risk Premium Thanks: Zhuo Huang acknowledges financial support by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (71671004) and Tianyi Wang acknowledges financial support by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (71871060).
arxiv-2112-05302.creator: Peter Reinhard Hansen & Zhuo Huang & Chen Tong & Tianyi Wang
arxiv-2112-05302.description: Abstract We show that the Realized GARCH model yields close-form expression for both the Volatility Index (VIX) and the volatility risk premium (VRP). The Realized GARCH model is driven by two shocks, a return shock and a volatility shock, and these are natural state variables in the stochastic discount factor (SDF).

arxiv-2210-17263.title: Maximal Polynomial Modulations of Singular Radon Transforms
arxiv-2210-17263.creator: Lars Becker
arxiv-2210-17263.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Lars Becker. We prove L 2 → L p L^{2}\to L^{p} estimates on the torus for maximal polynomial modulations of Calderón-Zygmund operators with anisotropic scaling. We obtain improved constants in these estimates. As a corollary, maximal polynomial modulations of a mollified version of the Hilbert transform along the parabola are bounded with only logarithmic dependence of the estimate on the Lipschitz constant of the mollifier. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2401-06760.title: Navigating the Metrics Maze: Reconciling Score Magnitudes and Accuracies
arxiv-2401-06760.creator: Tom Kocmi 1, Vilém Zouhar 2, Christian Federmann 1, Matt Post 1, vzouhar@ethz.ch
arxiv-2401-06760.description: Abstract Ten years ago, a single metric, BLEU, governed progress in machine translation research. For better or worse, there is no such consensus today, and consequently it is difficult for researchers to develop and retain intuitions about metric deltas that drove earlier research and deployment decisions.

arxiv-2401-12794.title: Benchmarking LLMs via Uncertainty Quantification
arxiv-2401-12794.creator: Fanghua Ye Mingming Yang Jianhui Pang Longyue Wang, Derek F. Wong Emine Yilmaz Shuming Shi Zhaopeng Tu
arxiv-2401-12794.description: Abstract The proliferation of open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) from various institutions has highlighted the urgent need for comprehensive evaluation methods. However, current evaluation platforms, such as the widely recognized HuggingFace open LLM leaderboard, neglect a crucial aspect – uncertainty , which is vital for thoroughly assessing LLMs.

arxiv-2402-07643.title: A Lattice-Reduction Aided Vector Perturbation Precoder Relying on Quantum Annealing
arxiv-2402-07643.creator: Samuel Winter, Yangyishi Zhang, Gan Zheng, Lajos Hanzo
arxiv-2402-07643.description: Abstract Quantum annealing (QA) is proposed for vector perturbation precoding (VPP) in multiple input multiple output (MIMO) communications systems. The mathematical framework of VPP is presented, outlining the problem formulation and the benefits of lattice reduction algorithms. Lattice reduction aided quantum vector perturbation (LRAQVP) is designed by harnessing physical quantum hardware, and the optimization of hardware parameters is discussed.

arxiv-2403-00153.title: Practical and Rich User Digitization
arxiv-2403-00153.creator: Karan Ahuja
arxiv-2403-00153.description: Abstract A long-standing vision in computer science has been to evolve computing devices into proactive assistants that enhance our productivity, health and wellness, and many other facets of our lives. User digitization is crucial in achieving this vision as it allows computers to intimately understand their users, capturing activity, pose, routine, and behavior.

arxiv-2406-05623.title: Observation Denoising in CYRUS Soccer Simulation 2D Team For RoboCup 2024
arxiv-2406-05623.creator: Nader Zare, Aref Sayareh, Sadra Khanjari, Arad Firouzkouhi
arxiv-2406-05623.description: Abstract In the Soccer Simulation 2D environment, accurate observation is crucial for effective decision-making. However, challenges such as partial observation and noisy data can hinder performance. To address these issues, we propose a denoising algorithm that leverages predictive modeling and intersection analysis to enhance the accuracy of observations.

arxiv-2501-04954.title: High-fidelity Generation of Bell and W States in Giant Atom System via Bound State in the Continuum
arxiv-2501-04954.creator: Mingzhu Weng, Hongwei Yu, Zhihai Wang
arxiv-2501-04954.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a high-fidelity scheme for generating entangled states in a system of two and three giant atoms coupled to the coupled resonator waveguide. Our approach leverages the bound state in the continuum, which is robust against waveguide disorder.

arxiv-2504-18987.title: Propagation of UHE cosmic rays in the light of f(R) gravity power-law model
arxiv-2504-18987.creator: Swaraj Pratim Sarmah
arxiv-2504-18987.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Swaraj Pratim Sarmah. While the origins of ultra-high energy (UHE) cosmic rays (CRs) remain shrouded in uncertainty, several important milestones have been reached in recent years in the experimental study of CRs with energy above 10 18 10^{18} eV. Within the vast expanse of intergalactic space, turbulent magnetic fields (TMFs) are believed to pervade, and these fields could exert a significant influence on the journey of UHECRs across the expanding Universe, which is currently undergoing acceleration.

arxiv-2511-10646.title: Ordinary lattice defects as probes of topology
arxiv-2511-10646.creator: Aiden J. Mains, Jia-Xin Zhong, Yun Jing, Bitan Roy
arxiv-2511-10646.description: Abstract In addition to topological lattice defects such as dislocations and disclinations, crystals are also accompanied by unavoidable ordinary defects, devoid of any non-trivial geometry or topology, among which vacancies, Schottky defects, substitutions, interstitials, and Frenkel pairs are the most common.

pmc-11320224.title: The impact of incomplete revascularization on survival in minimal invasive off-pump coronary artery surgery: a propensity score analysis of 1,149 cases
pmc-11320224.creator: Magdalena I. Rufa, Adrian Ursulescu, Juergen Dippon, Dincer Aktuerk, Samir Ahad, Ragi Nagib, Marc Albert, Ulrich Franke
pmc-11320224.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundMinimally invasive concepts are increasingly influential in modern cardiac surgery. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of completeness of revascularization on clinical outcomes and overall survival in minimally invasive, thoracoscopic coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) surgery.MethodsWe retrospectively evaluated a consecutive series of 1,149 patients who underwent minimally invasive off-pump CABG with single, double, or triple-vessel revascularization between 2007 and 2018. Of these patients, 185 (16.1%) had incomplete revascularization (IR) (group I), and 964 (83.9%) had complete revascularization (CR) (group C).

pmc-11692936.title: ASSOCIATIONS BETWEEN LIFE COURSE ADVERSITIES AND SUBJECTIVE VIEWS ON AGING
pmc-11692936.creator: Takeshi Nakagawa, Daisuke Ito, Saori Yasumoto
pmc-11692936.description: Recent research indicates that how individuals perceive their own aging may be influenced by negative life events or adversities in early life, such as war (Korniek et al., 2024). However, little is known about whether and when the impacts of adversities become salient across the lifespan. This study examined the associations between life course adversities and subjective views on aging.

pmc-12469629.title: Temporal Molecular Signatures of Early Human Clavicle Fracture Healing: Characterization of Hematological, Cytokine, and miRNA Profiles
pmc-12469629.creator: Li Wan, Sandra Failer, Nadja Muehlhaupt, Christina Schwenk, Peter Biberthaler, Conrad Ketzer, Gregor Roemmermann, Olivia Bohe, Marc Hanschen, Giacomina Brunetti
pmc-12469629.description: Fracture healing failure affects millions globally, yet early molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. This study aimed to characterize initial fracture response through analyzing peripheral blood hematology, multiplex cytokine profiles, and microRNA (miRNA) expression in fracture hematoma within the first 5 days post-injury.

pmc-12573607.title: Glenohumeral cerclage with anterior cruciate ligament guide suture retrieval for instability in reverse shoulder replacement
pmc-12573607.creator: Nathan Elder, Michael Vollant, Madison Kelly, Andrew Boltuch
pmc-12573607.description: studies have evaluated the complication profile associated with rTSA. The overall complication rate following rTSA has been shown to broadly range from 9.4% to 24% with a trend of decreasing complication rates noted in more recent studies likely attributable to improvements in surgical technique and implant design.

pmc-12706065.title: Exploring emotional learning and its impact on student behavior, well-being, and resilience using structural equation modeling
pmc-12706065.creator: Muhammad Younas, Dina Abdel Salam El-Dakhs, Yicun Jiang
pmc-12706065.description: Students’ mental health in the context of emotional learning is essential to their academic and personal development. Emotional learning affects students’ emotional intelligence, social support, psychological capital, and educational environment. Emotions significantly impact learning, academic achievement, and overall well-being. Thus, students’ emotional needs must be met, and supportive learning environments must be created.

pmc-12744874.title: Bevacizumab-Associated Bowel Perforation Causing Evisceration
pmc-12744874.creator: Maziar Fazel Darbandi, Garrett Johnson, Krista Hardy, Ashley Vergis
pmc-12744874.description: Bevacizumab is a monoclonal antibody that targets vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and inhibits angiogenesis in solid organ tumors. Its use in conjunction with fluorouracil-based chemotherapy for the management of metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC) has proven effective. There is a known, rare chance of gastrointestinal perforation associated with its use.

pmc-13333334.title: Clinical and Molecular Features of CNGA1-Associated Retinitis Pigmentosa in an East Asian Cohort: Insights for Gene Therapy Trials
pmc-13333334.creator: Zishi Liu, Jae Shin Song, Jieqiong Chen, Yidong Wu, Eun Kyoung Lee, Chang Ki Yoon, Yoon-Jeon Kim, Woojung Chae, Min Sagong, Zilin Wang, Hong Wang, Haoliang Zhang, Xujun Jiang, Hao Zhou, Huixun Jia, Junran Sun, Se Joon Woo, Tong Li, Xiaodong Sun
pmc-13333334.description: PurposeTo characterize the natural history of CNGA1-associated retinitis pigmentosa (RP) in an East Asian cohort and to identify potential endpoints for clinical trials.DesignA multicenter, retrospective cohort study.ParticipantsPatients diagnosed with CNGA1-associated RP.MethodsMedical records were reviewed for age at onset, symptoms, best-corrected visual acuity, ultra-widefield retinal imaging, spectral-domain OCT, full-field electroretinography, full-field stimulus threshold (FST), multiluminance mobility testing (MLMT), and static perimetry.

pmc-13357466.title: Antineoplastic effect of piperine compared with doxorubicin via suppressing γ-secretase/notch pathway in breast cancer cells
pmc-13357466.creator: Maha M Salem, Hamed A Abosharaf, Marian N Gerges, Mohamed A Abd El-Moneim, Tarek M Mohamed, Aliaa M Radwan
pmc-13357466.description: Breast carcinoma is the most prevalent and lethal malignancy affecting females, and it always presents an essential healthcare problem. Doxorubicin (DOX) is a common chemotherapy utilized in treating breast carcinoma, but it also has dangerous side effects. Hence, searching for potent and safe anticancer compounds is urgent.

pmc-13381380.title: Photobiomodulation for primary wound healing and patient-reported outcomes after esthetic crown lengthening surgery: A pilot randomized clinical trial
pmc-13381380.creator: Marcela Letícia da Silva Azevedo, Francisco Leonardo da Silva Júnior, Tasso Ehm Martins, Ádylla Rominne Lima Barbosa, Valkleidson Santos de Araújo, Régia Carla Medeiros da Silva, Mariana Linhares Almeida-Veloso, Euler Maciel Dantas, Bruno Cesar de Vasconcelos Gurgel, Ana Rafaela Luz de Aquino Martin
pmc-13381380.description: To evaluate the efficacy of photobiomodulation (PBM) on primary wound healing and patient-centered outcomes following esthetic clinical crown lengthening with osteotomy over a three-month follow-up period. Twenty-seven systemically healthy patients presenting < 10% bleeding on probing and altered passive eruption were enrolled in a split-mouth, triple-blind, randomized controlled clinical trial.

pmc-13389717.title: Beyond nocturnal hypercapnia: positioning obstructive sleep apnoea within a sleep–circadian–hypothalamic network
pmc-13389717.creator: Yu-Hsiang Lin, Kuo-Jen Lin, Jau-Yuan Chen
pmc-13389717.description: ExtractWe read with great interest the comprehensive review by Randerath et al. [1] on nocturnal hypercapnia in obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) and obesity hypoventilation syndrome (OHS). The authors elegantly highlighted that hypercapnia is not merely a mirror of hypoxia, but an active pathophysiological process influencing ventilatory drive, cerebral blood flow, autonomic activity and renal function.
